why: apiserver E (error) and W (warning) lines aggregated by source file. Shows which subsystem is noisy
query: fields @message | filter @logStream like /kube-apiserver-/ and @message like /^[EW][0-9]{4}/ | parse @message /^(?<lvl>[EW])[0-9]{4} \S+\s+\d+ (?<src>[a-zA-Z_]+\.go):\d+\]/ | stats count() as c by lvl, src | sort c desc | limit 25
